name: Strava Running
author: Bridger Middleton
description: Weekly running leaderboard, animated run cards with GPS route traces and pixel-art runners, a head-to-head race to a mileage goal, and streaks & records for a few Strava athletes.

versions.notes: Initial release: leaderboard, run cards, race, records.

api_requirements.name: Strava API
api_requirements.description: A Strava API application (client ID + secret) and one OAuth connection per athlete

web_ui_actions.title: Connect a Strava account
web_ui_actions.description: Generates a Strava authorization link. Open it (or send it to the athlete), approve, then paste the full URL of the page you land on (it starts with http://localhost/exchange_token).
web_ui_actions.step1_message: Open the link below, approve access, then copy the URL of the page you land on (it will fail to load, that is expected).
web_ui_actions.step2_prompt: Paste the full URL you were redirected to (http://localhost/exchange_token?...):
web_ui_actions.success_message: Strava account connected. Add the athlete to the Athletes table (or leave it blank to use their Strava first name), then save.
web_ui_actions.error_message: Could not complete the Strava connection. Check the client ID/secret and that you pasted the full redirect URL.
